beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Task text can be previewed without adding it to the work sample. Activate task adds it explicitly; Hide task removes it while keeping the text for later.
• Feedback and Task text boxes expand when the grading window has room.

Fixes:
• Fixed Windows beta updates failing to start with a QtCore DLL error. The installer now removes an obsolete ICU DLL left behind by earlier builds.
• Mini mode and the system tray now match the app's To-do count, including category preferences, and update together.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
